_about: Golden cases for configuration loading and command admission (config/allowlist/init in both editions). Each case is a configuration document (null for the built-in defaults), the value of HOME (null when the command does not use ~), and a command; the expectation is the admission, the refusal, or the configuration error, plus the warning line the configuration draws when one of its deny lists leaves out a built-in entry (absent when it draws none). Configuration errors name the file <config>; YAML errors are prefixed 'invalid YAML: '. earlier_configs are the configurations earlier releases wrote -- the files under earlier_configs/, kept byte for byte as each release's init wrote them or its user guide printed them, and (file null) the template this release writes -- loaded as earlier_location names them: the warning each draws, the value_options in force, what each admits, which upgrades (from upgrades, the table both editions' init --upgrade apply) rewrite it, and the same after the upgrade. Both unit-test suites load this file.
